_note: Flood outlines, road closures, operational posts, shelter availability and agency announcements are fictional exercise data. No government body endorses this scenario. Place labels describe a scenario; they do not verify real facilities or safe access. Map data and walking road geometry: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), with routes computed using the OSRM foot service. Routes do not avoid floods or the illustrated closures.

incidents.title: Bandar Sunway · Sunway–Monash flood
incidents.sourceLabel: Subang Jaya Flood Watch · drain gauge SJ-07
incidents.summary: Flash flooding between Monash University and South Quay after two hours of heavy rain. Jalan Lagoon Selatan is under water.

incidents.title: Shah Alam · Taman Sri Muda flood
incidents.summary: Drainage overflow along Taman Sri Muda’s residential streets. The deepest water is around Jalan Mewah; boat access replaces vehicles, with relief points north of the illustrated flood boundary.

incidents.title: Subang Jaya · USJ neighbourhood flash flood
incidents.summary: Rapid runoff across the USJ 9 residential junction and low-lying shop rows. Junctions and drainage crossings are closed; relief, triage and supply points are staged beyond the affected streets.

incidents.title: Klang · Bukit Raja river overflow
incidents.summary: A river-overflow exercise affecting low-lying Bandar Bukit Raja streets. Police access controls protect a crossing while rescue and welfare teams coordinate from points beyond the illustrated flood boundary.

severe: Go to the highest floor you can reach now. Do not wait.
Stay out of the water. Moving water 15 cm deep can knock you over.
Switch off electricity at the mains if you can reach it safely.
If you cannot leave, call 999 or send a rescue request.
high: Leave for the nearest safe zone now if the way is clear.
Take only your phone, ID, medicine and water.
If water blocks the way, go upstairs and request help.
moderate: Get ready to leave. Charge your phone and pack ID and medicine.
Move vehicles and valuables to higher ground if it is safe.
Check on neighbours who may need help.
Leave for a safe zone if the water rises.

alerts.title: Flash flood at Sunway–Monash
alerts.text: Jalan Lagoon Selatan is closed in this exercise. Rescue crews are staged north of the flood boundary.

alerts.title: Taman Sri Muda residential roads flooded
alerts.text: The Jalan Mewah pocket is the deepest zone in this exercise. Vehicle access is restricted; boat crews are being coordinated.

alerts.title: USJ 9 junction closed
alerts.text: Rapid runoff affects USJ 9 and the lower USJ 9 streets. Use the map to locate the illustrated closures and response posts.

alerts.title: Bukit Raja river crossing restricted
alerts.text: River overflow affects the Bukit Raja western approach. A police roadblock and rescue launch are marked on the scenario map.

alerts.title: Seksyen 25 relief reception ready
alerts.text: In this exercise, the northern school hall receives families, with water, bedding and a registration desk.

alerts.title: USJ 7 relief and medical posts ready
alerts.text: In this exercise, the relief hall receives families while the medical post handles first aid and ambulance handover.

alerts.title: Bukit Raja relief points receiving families
alerts.text: In this exercise, two relief points beyond the southern flood boundary provide meals, bedding and family registration.

alerts.title: Federal coordination desk activated
alerts.text: Exercise bulletin: the Prime Minister’s Office coordination desk in Putrajaya is receiving district situation reports. This is a fictional announcement.

alerts.title: Sunway University relief point opens
alerts.text: Exercise update: water, blankets and charging points are ready at the North Building.

alerts.title: Additional boats assigned to Sri Muda
alerts.text: Exercise update: a second rescue unit is assigned to the residential pocket; the launch access must stay clear.

alerts.title: USJ 9 police diversion extended
alerts.text: Exercise update: vehicle access remains closed while standing water covers the junction.

alerts.title: Water and bedding delivered to Bukit Raja
alerts.text: Exercise update: welfare supplies reach both relief points. Distribution follows family registration.

alerts.title: BRT interchange access restricted
alerts.text: Exercise update: the South Quay access is restricted. The scenario does not confirm the status of real transport services.

alerts.title: Health team sets up triage
alerts.text: Exercise update: a clinic team starts first aid and medicine enquiries at the northern medical post.

alerts.title: Drain blockage inspection requested
alerts.text: Exercise update: public works engineers are checking the USJ drainage crossing. No reopening has been approved.

alerts.title: River crossing remains closed
alerts.text: Exercise update: the river-side barrier remains in place while teams check the road edge and water level.

alerts.title: Aid convoy dispatched from Putrajaya
alerts.text: Exercise bulletin: a fictional federal logistics convoy is assigned water, blankets and generators for district relief points.

alerts.title: Family enquiry desk starts at Seksyen 25
alerts.text: Exercise update: the welfare desk records separated-family enquiries and helps match registrations between relief points.

alerts.title: Rescue crew reaches the USJ staging point
alerts.text: Exercise update: boat trailers and first-aid equipment are staged north of the flooded streets.

alerts.title: Power inspection planned after water recedes
alerts.text: Exercise update: utility engineers will inspect affected equipment before any restoration decision. This does not report a real outage.

alerts.title: Second boat unit assigned to Monash
alerts.text: Exercise update: the Sunway operations desk assigns another boat crew to the Monash side of the scenario.

alerts.title: Road damage survey requested
alerts.text: Exercise update: municipal engineers will document drain and road damage after access becomes safe. This is not a finding of fault.

alerts.title: USJ water levels easing; barriers remain
alerts.text: Exercise update: illustrated conditions are stabilising, but the closed roads remain blocked pending a physical inspection. Map boundaries stay fixed for repeatable testing.

alerts.title: Fresh meals reach Bukit Raja shelters
alerts.text: Exercise update: another delivery of meals and drinking water reaches the registered relief points.

alerts.title: District recovery assessments coordinated
alerts.text: Exercise bulletin: district reports are collected for a fictional federal recovery review. No real aid entitlement or payment is announced.

alerts.title: Neighbourhood clean-up assessment scheduled
alerts.text: Exercise update: municipal crews plan a drainage and debris assessment once the response lead permits access.

alerts.title: River-side engineering review continues
alerts.text: Exercise update: the crossing stays closed until the scenario response lead signs off the engineering review.
